courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 懸掛式單軌轉轍系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「導向道測量角度誤差」與「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Angular error in guideway surveying" and "Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Suspended-monorail switch systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以空間頻譜與測量不確定度控制磁浮導梁精度；懸掛式單軌轉轍系統則以懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on maglev guideway precision through spatial spectra and survey uncertainty; Suspended-monorail switch systems centres on load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「導向道測量角度誤差」與「可動構件力行程帳」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到懸掛式單軌轉轍系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「動作回授的事件次序」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Angular error in guideway surveying” and “Force-travel work of moving members”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Suspended-monorail switch systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Event ordering in actuator feedback", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「導向道測量角度誤差」與「需求介面與試驗追溯」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rail-system integration testing and trial running, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Integrated modes and unknown states", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1994 年磁浮導梁施工精度與乘坐研究出版。；1998 年梁式磁浮導向道施工精度研究出版。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對以空間頻譜與測量不確定度控制磁浮導梁精度而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用精度帳的獨立與相關成分及測量施工與運行邊界連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1994: Research linking maglev guideway precision and ride was published. 1998: Research on beam-type maglev guideway construction accuracy was published. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For maglev guideway precision through spatial spectra and survey uncertainty, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through independent and correlated precision terms and survey, construction and running cases. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
